title: Live e2e suite
description: Tier 5 lives in vitest.live.config.ts and never runs in pnpm test or pnpm check, because a flaky third party must not block a commit. tests/live/smoke.live.test.ts holds 6 it.todo cases: vibeflow posting a real envelope for a 202, a background turn producing zero Telegram output, an explicit notify reaching the chat, a reply keeping event context, sequential handling of several webhooks during a busy turn, and restart recovering the session while losing only queued events.
author: Tomislav Zorcec
